label: A first being is in POTENCY_2 in no respect now, from plenitude
description: An analyst reconstruction of Theta.8's priority in substance of act as the end of potency (1050a4-b2), read with the tertia via's plenitude premise: a first being in potency in a respect now can be in act in it; given an infinite past, whatever is possible was realized at some earlier time, so the first being was once in act in that respect; whatever was in act in a respect and is later in potency in it has an efficient cause other than itself, which is simply prior to it (ST I q.2 a.3 reading), against firstness. The conclusion is the q.3 a.1 conclusion with potency taken at the time now. It uses no composition premise and no cause of composites; it shares only efficient-cause priority with the composition routes. Each of the five premises is needed and the route is not vacuous (Control.PlenitudeOmissions). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
